name: dot1qVlanStaticTable
description: A table containing static configuration information for each VLAN configured into the device by (local or network) management. All entries are permanent and will be restored after the device is reset.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.2.1.2.name: dot1qVlanIndex
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.2.1.2.description: The VLAN-ID or other identifier referring to this VLAN.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.1.name: dot1qVlanStaticName
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.1.description: An administratively assigned string, which may be used to identify the VLAN.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.2.name: dot1qVlanStaticEgressPorts
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.2.description: The set of ports that are permanently assigned to the egress list for this VLAN by management. Changes to a bit in this object affect the per-port, per-VLAN Registrar control for Registration Fixed for the relevant GVRP state machine on each port. A port may not be added in this set if it is already a member of the set of ports in dot1qVlanForbiddenEgressPorts. The default value of this object is a string of zeros of appropriate length, indicating not fixed.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.3.name: dot1qVlanForbiddenEgressPorts
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.3.description: The set of ports that are prohibited by management from being included in the egress list for this VLAN. Changes to this object that cause a port to be included or excluded affect the per-port, per-VLAN Registrar control for Registration Forbidden for the relevant GVRP state machine on each port. A port may not be added in this set if it is already a member of the set of ports in dot1qVlanStaticEgressPorts. The default value of this object is a string of zeros of appropriate length, excluding all ports from the forbidden set.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.4.name: dot1qVlanStaticUntaggedPorts
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.4.description: The set of ports that should transmit egress packets for this VLAN as untagged. The default value of this object for the default VLAN (dot1qVlanIndex = 1) is a string of appropriate length including all ports. There is no specified default for other VLANs. If a device agent cannot support the set of ports being set, then it will reject the set operation with an error. For example, a manager might attempt to set more than one VLAN to be untagged on egress where the device does not support this IEEE 802.1Q option.

.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.5.name: dot1qVlanStaticRowStatus
.1.3.6.1.2.1.17.7.1.4.3.1.5.description: This object indicates the status of this entry.
